title: Prose Cat6 UTP Patch Cord 1M Premium RJ45 Ethernet LAN Cable

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UTP Patch Cord Cat6 Cable 1M Premium RJ45 Ethernet LAN Network Cord is a high-quality and reliable networking cable designed for fast, stable, and interference-free connectivity. This premium Cat6 cable supports up to 1Gbps Gigabit Ethernet and is ideal for short-distance connections in home, office, and professional IT setups.


With durable UTP construction and precision-molded RJ45 connectors, this 1-meter patch cord ensures superior signal integrity, reduced crosstalk, and long-lasting performance. Perfect for connecting routers, PCs, laptops, gaming consoles, CCTV devices, switches, IP phones, smart TVs, and more.


Key Features

  • 1 Meter premium Cat6 UTP patch cord
  • Supports 1Gbps Gigabit Ethernet speeds
  • High-quality RJ45 connectors for stable, secure connections
  • Low interference and minimal signal loss
  • Durable PVC jacket suitable for indoor use
  • Ideal for routers, modems, PCs, switches, servers, and CCTV
  • Easy plug-and-play installation
  • Perfect for home, office, and small networking setups
